documents.title: Bambu PETG HF Technical Data Sheet V1.0
Bambu PETG HF Safety Data Sheet (SDS20250724G02)
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: TDS rows with no registry key (not stored): Spool Material "ABS (Temperature resistance 70 °C)", Spool Size "Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm", Printing and Storage Humidity "< 20% RH (Sealed, with desiccant)", Bed Surface Preparation "Glue", Retraction Length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, Retraction Speed 30 - 60 mm/s, Max Overhang Angle ~ 70 °, Max Bridging Length ~ 30 mm, Support Material "Support for PETG", Melt Index 28.2 ± 2.7 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.40% (25 °C, 55% RH), Young's Modulus 1810 ± 190 MPa (X-Y) / 1540 ± 130 MPa (Z), Crystallization Temperature N/A, chemical resistance and flammability rows.
Z-direction mechanical values and the 1.8 MPa HDT are kept only in the notes of their rows: the registry has one key per property and the X-Y / 0.45 MPa values are stored.
SDS SDS20250724G02: Density, Melting Point and every other physical property read "No data available"; Composition PETG 85-99 (CAS 25640-14-6). No number is taken from the SDS.

Drying sources disagree slightly: TDS blast drying oven 65 °C, 8 h (stored) = wiki material table 65 ℃ for 8 h; PETG wiki: convection oven 60 - 65 °C, 8 h, heat bed 80 °C, 12 h, AMS HT / AMS 2 Pro 65 °C, 8 h; wiki material table: AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT 65 ℃ for 12 h; TDS heatbed alternative: X1 Series Printer Heatbed 75 - 85 °C, 12 h. The dry-filament wiki row is "PETG, PETG-CF" (does not name PETG HF) and is not used.

Build plate: the wiki material table marks Bambu Cool Plate / PLA Plate "Not recommended" for PETG / PETG HF / PETG Translucent; recorded here, not as not_compatible_with (not recommended is not incompatible). The store FAQ says "Compatible with all printers, AMS, build plate, and nozzles."

material.diameter_tolerance (±0.03 mm), material.spool_type (Refill / Filament with spool) and safety.certifications (a "Filament RoHS" certificate link) are published on the store page, so they are not listed as not_published.
PETG wiki: for un-dried PETG HF it suggests the Generic PETG HF preset (nozzle temperature 220 ℃, volume speed 16 mm³/s); a workaround, not a manufacturer spec, not stored.
in_the_box: no official in-the-box list for this filament in the documents read (the store page has none either).
The hex table lists exactly the 14 colour values of the store page; no extra or missing colour.
